utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I want to make sure the timing and pickup details are clear first. What day are we aiming for, and where should I bring everything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re aiming for Saturday morning, and you can bring everything to my garage on Maple Street. I’ll be there to help unload when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning at your garage on Maple Street works for me. What time should I plan to arrive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make the repair drive work around school pickup if we keep it early. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Early works for me—maybe around 8? I can bring the broken lamp and the wobbly chair.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 8 should work for me if we keep it quick. I’ll swing by after drop-off and help load them up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m happy to help, but can you give me the key details for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits second-hand, but I can pass along what I know and ask around for the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Nell—just the basics are fine for now. What’s been confirmed so far?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d start with the loose fence panel by the side gate — it’s the most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll start with the side gate fence panel.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out—what kind of repairs are needed?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly little stuff—some loose hinges, a leaky faucet, and a couple of broken shelves. If you’re around later, I’d really appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can stop by later and help with those.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m here—what details do you need checked for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got on hand and what we’re still short on for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That’d be great—please check both the supplies we have and anything we still need. If you can, note the counts so we can compare them easily.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I’m happy to help; just tell me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thank you! We’re meeting by the community shed at 4, and I’ll hand you whatever tasks are left when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn—community shed at 4, got it. I’ll be there and ready for whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Mara—thank you. We still need someone to track tool donations and another person to help sort supplies on Saturday; which part would you like to take?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can track the tool donations—send me the list, and I’ll keep it organized. If you still need an extra hand on Saturday, I can help sort supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked the repair drive location yet, but I can keep an eye out and let you know as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Opal. Let me know as soon as you find the repair drive location.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I will—I'll check around and tell you as soon as I find the repair drive location.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll go ahead and tell the others about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest update, but I’m around if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Noah — can you confirm if you’re actually free later, or just maybe?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m actually free later — just give me a time and I’ll try to be there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. Could you help sort the donations by type and set up the table on Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I can sort the donations by type and set up the table Saturday morning. Just tell me what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what needs fixing first, and when are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We should start with the urgent fixes first, then sort the rest by what we can actually get done this week. If you want, I can help lay out a simple schedule so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good—let’s make the urgent fixes first and put the rest on a simple schedule for this week.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, nice — I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet. What’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet—can you confirm when it’s happening and what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can check with the folks organizing it and get back to you. I’ll stop by after my errand and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just tell me the basics for the repair drive, and I’ll go with that.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re collecting tools, tape, screws, and any spare parts folks can spare. I’ll keep track of what comes in and make sure it gets where it’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I can bring some spare screws and tape.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’ve got the repair drive notes ready, and I’m happy to help get things organized. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the biggest fixes first, then sort the rest by cost and urgency.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That works for me — I’ll list the biggest fixes first, then rank everything by cost and urgency so we can make a clear plan.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — could you bring a hammer, a tape measure, and a couple of screwdrivers? If you can, come by Saturday morning and help us sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring the hammer, tape measure, and screwdrivers, and I’ll come by Saturday morning to help sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, definitely—I'll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If you want, I can help invite a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’d really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start by talking to folks on our block and see who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet, but I can keep an eye on where the repair drive is happening and let you know if I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — I’d really appreciate that. I’m still piecing it together from the grapevine.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I’ll watch for any signs or flyers and let you know as soon as I find the location.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I keep meaning to ask what still needs doing. Want me to help with something specific?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, that’d be great — I’m still sorting what’s left, and I can let you know the next thing that needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — just point me at the next thing when you know it, and I’ll give it a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bridge folks for the repair drive—who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — maybe start with Mrs. Patel on Maple and Ben at the corner house. I’m a bit scattered today, but they’d probably be a good first pass.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll start with Mrs. Patel and Ben, then let you know what they say.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard any fresh details yet, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess—appreciate it. If you need any tools for the repair drive, just give me a holler.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Gus—thanks! I’ll swing by if I hear anyone needs a hand or a tool.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — I’ll double-check the details before I act. What time and place are we using for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let’s use Saturday at 10 a.m. by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — Saturday at 10 a.m. by the community center. I’ll keep that noted and check any other details before we go ahead.
